therapist.title: Payments and invoices
therapist.lead: Who has paid, who still has to pay, and every invoice sent in your name.
therapist.welcomeStep1: At the top you see who still has to pay you. When someone pays, tap “Payment received”.
therapist.welcomeStep2: Once a session is fully paid, the invoice is made and e-mailed to your client for you. You don't have to do anything.
therapist.welcomeStep3: Client pays later by bank transfer? Tap “Send invoice” and they get the invoice by e-mail straight away.
therapist.tileOutstandingHint: {count, plural, =0 {Everyone has paid} one {# session} other {# sessions}}
therapist.tileInvoicedHint: {count, plural, =0 {No invoices} one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}
therapist.outstandingEmptyText: Sessions that still need paying will show up here.
therapist.invoiceSentText: Your client gets the invoice by e-mail.

admin.title: Room-rent invoices
admin.lead: Prepare, check and send the monthly rent invoices, and see who has paid.
admin.welcomeStep1: Choose the month. Tap “Prepare invoices”: the portal works out each renter's rent from their room and booked blocks.
admin.welcomeStep2: Check the amounts. Happy? Tap “Send invoices”. Each renter gets their invoice by e-mail with the PDF.
admin.welcomeStep3: When the money is in your bank account, tap “Mark as paid”. Soon the bank link will do this for you.
admin.tileOpenHint: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing open} one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}
admin.owesEmpty: All rent invoices have been paid.
admin.nothingYet: No invoices for this month yet.
admin.nothingYetText: Tap the button to work out everyone's rent. Nothing is sent until you check it.
admin.nothingToBill: There is no rent to bill for this month.
admin.draftsLead: These invoices have not been sent yet. You can still change rates or blocks and work them out again.
admin.send: Send {count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}
admin.sendConfirmText: {count, plural, one {# renter gets} other {# renters get}} an invoice by e-mail. After sending, an invoice cannot be changed.
admin.sentText: Each renter gets their invoice by e-mail.
